title: Forgotten Power
description: Abilities, reforged weapons, new dimensions - discover the power long forgotten
body:
# Forgotten Power

**Forgotten Power** is an adventure–RPG modpack focused on **abilities, subclasses, powerful weapons, and new worlds to explore**.  
Fight through dangerous dimensions, develop unique combat styles, craft highly customizable equipment, and uncover ancient powers long lost to time.

### Features

- **RPG Progression**: Choose unique origins, abilities, attributes, and skill trees to shape your own playstyle.
- **Expanded Combat**: Wield a wide variety of weapons and shields, enhanced gear, powerful materials, and reworked netherite equipment.
- **Modular Crafting**: Use Tetra, Silent Gear, Silent's Gems, and their addons to forge and customize equipment to suit your build.
- **Unique Abilities**: Combine Origins, Origins++, Pufferfish's Skills, and additional attributes to create powerful and distinct characters.
- **New Dimensions**: Explore the Otherside, Undergarden, and Better End, each offering new environments, enemies, resources, and late-game challenges.
- **Stronger Enemies**: Face dangerous mobs and powerful encounters designed to challenge your growing strength.
- **Improved Exploration**: Discover expanded terrain, new biomes, enhanced structures, and more interesting worlds to explore.
- **Survive Your Way**: Backpacks, corpse recovery, expanded storage, and improved inventory features make long adventures more manageable.
- **Better Navigation**: Xaero's Minimap and World Map help you keep track of your discoveries and navigate the expanded world.
- **Polished Experience**: Performance improvements, connected textures, shaders, visual enhancements, and numerous quality-of-life features make the adventure smoother and more immersive.
